mapper.sql: definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, definition_id AS definitionId, version_no AS versionNo, status, graph_json AS graphJson, start_form_json AS startFormJson, action_snapshot_json AS actionSnapshotJson, published_by AS publishedBy, published_time AS publishedTime, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_workflow_definition_version (definition_version_id, definition_id, version_no, status, graph_json, start_form_json, action_snapshot_json, published_by, published_time, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.definitionVersionId}, #{row.definitionId}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.status}, #{row.graphJson}, #{row.startFormJson}, #{row.actionSnapshotJson}, #{row.publishedBy}, #{row.publishedTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_workflow_definition_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}

SELECT definition_version_id AS definitionVersionId, definition_id AS definitionId, version_no AS versionNo, status, published_by AS publishedBy, published_time AS publishedTime, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_workflow_definition_version WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_workflow_definition_version SET status = 'PUBLISHED', action_snapshot_json = #{row.actionSnapshotJson}, published_by = #{row.publishedBy}, published_time = #{row.publishedTime}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{row.updatedBy}, update_time = #{row.updateTime} WHERE definition_version_id = #{row.definitionVersionId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'DRAFT'
